page: Amazon Web Services d3en.xlarge is a dense storage-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro System. It is powered by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8259CL processor with x86_64 architecture, providing 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. The instance features 16.0 GB of DDR4 system memory running at 3 GHz, delivering 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware resources also include 6 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and an integrated local storage array consisting of 27,960 GB of hard disk drive (HDD) capacity.

Benchmark evaluations highlight that compute performance is restrained by the modest core count. The instance achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1,104.0 and a multi-core score of 2,421.0, accompanied by a PassMark CPU score of 4,108.76 and stress-ng multi-core throughput of 3,485.87, placing its raw compute metrics in the bottom quartile. Memory subsystems perform stably, registering 27.34 GB/sec uncached read bandwidth and 23.27 GB/sec uncached write bandwidth, resulting in an average PassMark memory score of 1,906.38.

The primary architectural tradeoff is focused on capacity over processing speed. The bundled local HDD array delivers massive dense storage per compute unit, which offers exceptional qualitative cost efficiency for capacity-heavy data footprints compared to solid-state alternatives. However, the mechanical drive nature and entry-level compute resources limit responsiveness for latency-sensitive or IOPS-heavy transactions. The d3en.xlarge is best suited for big data clusters, data lakes, Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) nodes, sequential log processing, and cold or warm data archiving.
description: Amazon Web Services d3en.xlarge is a storage-optimized virtual machine operating on the Nitro hypervisor, designed for workloads requiring massive local capacity. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8259CL processor running at 3.1 GHz, featuring 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores, 16.0 GB of DDR4 memory, and a 6 Gbps baseline network interface. The defining hardware feature is an integrated 27,960 GB HDD local storage volume. Benchmark metrics reveal modest compute capability, with bottom-quartile results across Geekbench and PassMark CPU evaluations, balanced by median-tier memory bandwidth. Consequently, the instance offers strong cost efficiency per terabyte for sequential data retention rather than compute-intensive calculations. The d3en.xlarge is ideally configured for capacity-oriented workloads including data lakes, distributed file systems, log aggregation, and large-scale data backup pipelines.
